stdout: package: @astryxdesign/lab # DialogHeroHeader 像 DialogHeader 一样放入 Dialog 内 Layout 的 header 插槽。当对话框呈现精选、营销或引导场景，紧凑的 DialogHeader 不够醒目时使用。媒体自动延伸到对话框边缘，关闭按钮浮动在媒体的尾部上角。可见标题是默认的初始焦点目标；内联预览不会移动焦点。安装 @astryxdesign/lab@canary 和 @astryxdesign/core@canary，并导入两个包的 CSS。Lab API 可能在 canary 版本之间变化。 **Import:** `import {DialogHeroHeader} from '@astryxdesign/lab';` ## Best Practices - **Do:** 让 mediaMode 与媒体的明暗匹配，保证浮动关闭按钮清晰可读：深色图片需要 mediaMode="dark"。 - **Do:** 让媒体内容填满插槽（图片用 width 100%）；插槽本身只负责定位和延伸。 - **Do:** 操作按钮（CTA）放在 LayoutFooter；hero 头部不提供操作插槽。 - **Do:** 当媒体已经在视觉上传达信息时使用 isTitleHidden；标题仍会为屏幕阅读器命名对话框。 - **Don't:** 用于常规确认或表单；请改用紧凑的 DialogHeader。 - **Don't:** 装饰性媒体缺少空 alt；纯装饰图片请使用 alt="" 让屏幕阅读器跳过。 ## Props | Prop | Type | Default | Description | |------|------|---------|-------------| | `title` | `string \| ReactElement` | - | Dialog title. A string is wrapped in a level 2 Heading (matching DialogHeader); pass a pre-styled Heading element to customize the treatment. Provides the accessible label for the parent Dialog via aria-labelledby unless the Dialog has an explicit label. The visible title is the default initial focus target; another eligible descendant autofocus request takes priority. A custom Heading receives the label and focus on its own element; if it sets its own id, name the Dialog with aria-labelledby. **(required)** | | `media` | `ReactNode` | - | Full-bleed visual rendered above the title (image, illustration, or icon). Stretches to the dialog's padded edges; the close button overlays its top-trailing corner. Size the media itself (e.g. width 100%) to fill the slot. **(required)** | | `mediaMode` | `'light' \| 'dark'` | - | Luminance of the media surface. Composes MediaTheme under the hood so content overlaid on the media (the close button) picks up contrast-safe inverted tokens: 'dark' media gets light overlay content, 'light' media gets dark. Omit to keep ambient theme tokens. | | `isTitleHidden` | `boolean` | `false` | Visually hides the title row while keeping it available to screen readers, so the dialog stays named by the title. | | `startContent` | `ReactNode` | - | Content placed before the title (e.g. an icon), inline with the heading. | | `maxLines` | `number` | - | Max lines before the title truncates with an ellipsis. Only applies when title is a string (auto-wrapped in a Heading). | | `onOpenChange` | `(isOpen: boolean) => unknown` | - | Close button callback, called with false when the close button is clicked. If not provided, no close button is rendered. Same contract as DialogHeader. | | `hasDivider` | `boolean` | - | Adds a themed border at the bottom edge. Defaults to the parent Layout's defaultHasDividers context value. | ## Examples ### Onboarding dialog ```tsx import {DialogHeroHeader} from '@astryxdesign/lab'; import '@astryxdesign/core/astryx.css'; import '@astryxdesign/lab/lab.css'; const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(true); } mediaMode="dark" onOpenChange={setIsOpen} /> } content={Get started in three steps.} footer={ ``` ### Hidden title (media carries the message) ```tsx } isTitleHidden onOpenChange={setIsOpen} /> ```
